In this card, you can either choose to play one of the characters, or spectate and see how it all unfolds.

The characters:
- Malice Philemon (the incubus / book)
- Jenny Wallace
- Jan Wallace (mother of Jenny, would appear either to interrupt Jenny's possession, or later to find the book)
- Claire Wallace (sister of Jenny, see Jan)
- Father Hopkins (would appear alongside Sister Anne at school or the library, or would end up at Jenny's place, having tracked the book)
- Sister Anne (See Father Hopkins)

Or you can play as your own persona.

[UPDATE: Added lore entries for the corruption event, in an attempt to drive the story forward. We'll see how this pans out.]


FULL DISCLOSURE: The LLM may attempt to play as the character you selected, as the LLM will the narrator of this entire story. What you will say will override any decision it may take. Note that if you play as your persona, the card will behave like any other card. Same if you choose to spectate.

Also, smaller models may have a hard time with that one.

This is the first time I'm undertaking such a project for a card. It may work great, or it may fail. And if it fails, so be it. :P Feel free to let me know.
